text: It is very overpriced and not very tasty.
But the staff was so horrible to us.
Each table has a pot of boiling water sunken into its surface and you get platters of thin sliced meats various vegetables and rice and glass noodles.

aspect_breakdown.food: thin sliced meats, vegetables, rice, glass noodles

text: The soft jazz music and warm candlelight made our evening romantic, even though the bill was shockingly steep.
Waiters refilled our water promptly, the pasta was cooked to perfect al dente, and the atmosphere felt like an authentic Roman trattoria.
The location is easy to reach by subway and there is plenty of bike parking nearby.
